name: second-brain-kit
description: A working method for Claude Code, set up by Claude. Claude picks the level at install: Basic (one main session in a numbered notes folder, a work list Claude keeps, evidence-before-done checks and safety hooks) or Full (Basic + only the topic sessions, reminders or other-tool guide your answers and history call for). A weekly check offers more parts when measured numbers show they would help, only with your yes. One Claude account is enough.
